blocks.text:
To: Barbara Blair
Cc: Richard Henderson, Kelly Snyder

I want to add one thing to Richard Henderson's note. When the descriptions reach us, the more precisely they pin down each feature, the more precisely we can clear it. A general description tends to produce a general answer, and on a freedom-to-operate question a general answer is worth very little.

So where it is workable on your side, mark which features matter most to the products {{fact:f:E-2020-001.client}} is actually taking to market. Kelly Snyder and Richard Henderson will scope the searches to those first, and I will hold any conclusion until the searching behind it is complete.
